decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the roof extension is occupied.
Condition : 4 - The two rooflights on the front plane of the roof hereby approved, shall be flat conservation style rooflights.

Condition : 5 - It is considered that this application for the erection of rear roof extension and repositioning of rooflights to provide two rooflights, front and rear, because of its position,  design and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for  the site characteristics of number 26 Highfield Road  and is  complementary to the visual amenity of the locality and would not be  detrimental to the amenities of adjoining and neighbouring properties 
and will continue to preserve the character of the Conservation Area.  
The development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B 1.1 (New Development), ENVB 2.2 (Conservation Areas)  and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted  December 2003; and is compliant with Council's "Residential Extension Guidelines".
description: Erection of a rear roof extension and repositioning of rooflights  to provide two rooflights front and rear to existing dwellinghouse.
